responsibility: Declares the loop-transformation API exported by `cfgloopmanip.cc`. It defines flags controlling preheader creation and loop-body duplication behavior, exposes helpers for removing paths, placing and adding loops, scaling loop frequencies/profile, creating empty if/loop regions, unlooping, copying and duplicating loop metadata or bodies, forcing single-successor latches, creating preheaders, and performing loop versioning, forming the public interface for CFG-level loop rewrites.
same_name_distinction: Provides the public declarations, flags, and entry points for loop CFG manipulation, whereas cfgloopmanip.cc contains the concrete algorithms and CFG/loop-tree update machinery.
